title: kblane.commit_paths drops an entry when either mode is a gitlink, so a plain file that replaces a kb gitlink (or the reverse) is left out and the commit counts as content
goal: kblane.commit_paths leaves an entry out only when every non-zero mode of it is 160000

run:
import subprocess,sys,tempfile,os
sys.path.insert(0,"_tools")
import kblane
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
def g(*a): return subprocess.run(["git","-c","user.name=t","-c","user.email=t@example.com",*a],cwd=d,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
g("init","-q")
g("update-index","--add","--cacheinfo","160000,"+"1"*40+",kb/team")
g("commit","-qm","link")
g("rm","-q","--cached","kb/team")
os.makedirs(d+"/kb",exist_ok=True)
open(d+"/kb/team","w").write("x")
g("add","kb/team")
g("commit","-qm","file")
sys.exit(0 if kblane.commit_paths(d,"HEAD")==["kb/team"] else 1)

repro_reason: needs a repository where a commit turns the gitlink kb/team into a regular file; the planted input is in the notes
notes: SP-mut2pmu3 review gap 5 (S3). kblane.py:100-103 tests _GITLINK in modes, so either mode being 160000 drops the entry. Planted: a commit that turns the gitlink kb/team into a regular file kb/team gives commit_paths -> [] (content), where a regular kb/README.md is code. Fix: drop only when old and new are each 000000 or 160000. Planned in SP-wjrxikw6 2026-11-10: touches, order and repro checked against the base.
